features.label: Eyes
features.tip: Soft blue-gray, with a delicate slate ring.

features.label: Brows
features.tip: Ash-brown, with a naturally gentle arch.

features.label: Nose
features.tip: A softly defined bridge and rounded tip.

features.label: Lips
features.tip: A muted rosy tone with a defined Cupid’s bow.

Work.title: Quietly confident
Work.tagline: Polished, soft, and ready for your 9-to-5.

makeup.label: Base
makeup.tip: Sheer cool-neutral skin tint; conceal only where needed.

makeup.label: Eyes
makeup.tip: Matte taupe on the lids and a fine slate lash line.

makeup.label: Blush
makeup.tip: Sweep dusty rose high on the cheeks for a subtle lift.

makeup.label: Lips
makeup.tip: A rose-mauve satin lipstick that stays neat through meetings.

makeup.label: Finish
makeup.tip: Set the T-zone with translucent powder; keep cheeks natural.

outfit.label: Pieces
outfit.tip: Dove-gray tailored trousers with a powder-blue blouse.

outfit.label: Extras
outfit.tip: Soft navy loafers and a structured gray tote.

outfit.label: Jewelry
outfit.tip: Small silver hoops and a fine silver watch.

hair.label: Style
hair.tip: A smooth, low ponytail with a soft side part.

hair.label: Detail
hair.tip: Tuck flyaways with a little cream, not wet-look gel.

Work.goodToKnow: Check your blush in daylight before leaving; office lighting can make cool tones look washed out.

Date.title: A little rosy
Date.tagline: Easy romance for coffee and a long conversation.

makeup.label: Base
makeup.tip: Dewy skin tint and spot concealer for a fresh close-up finish.

makeup.label: Eyes
makeup.tip: Blend soft mauve shadow and one coat of brown-black mascara.

makeup.label: Blush
makeup.tip: Tap cool pink cream blush onto the apples of your cheeks.

makeup.label: Lips
makeup.tip: Choose a rosy tinted balm that is easy to reapply at the table.

makeup.label: Finish
makeup.tip: A tiny touch of pearl highlight on the cheekbones, never glitter.

outfit.label: Pieces
outfit.tip: A dusty-rose knit with light-wash straight jeans.

outfit.label: Extras
outfit.tip: Dove-gray ballet flats and a small crossbody bag.

outfit.label: Jewelry
outfit.tip: A fine silver pendant and tiny pearl studs.

hair.label: Style
hair.tip: Loose, touchable waves with a natural center part.

hair.label: Detail
hair.tip: Keep one side tucked behind your ear to show your earrings.

Date.goodToKnow: A tinted balm handles coffee better than a glossy lipstick; keep it in your crossbody.

Date night.title: After-hours muse
Date night.tagline: Soft smoky eyes, a little candlelit allure.

makeup.label: Base
makeup.tip: Medium-coverage cool-neutral foundation, blended down the neck.

makeup.label: Eyes
makeup.tip: Smudge plum at the outer corners and slate along the lashes.

makeup.label: Blush
makeup.tip: Place a sheer berry blush just above the cheek hollow.

makeup.label: Lips
makeup.tip: Line with muted berry and fill with satin rose for dinner.

makeup.label: Finish
makeup.tip: Set around the nose and add a cool pearl sheen to cheeks.

outfit.label: Pieces
outfit.tip: A soft navy slip dress under a cropped dove-gray jacket.

outfit.label: Extras
outfit.tip: Slate heels and a small plum evening bag.

outfit.label: Jewelry
outfit.tip: Silver drop earrings; let the neckline stay clean.

hair.label: Style
hair.tip: A low, loose chignon with soft face-framing strands.

hair.label: Detail
hair.tip: Use a discreet silver pin and a light mist of flexible spray.

Date night.goodToKnow: Candlelight warms every shade; cool berry lips keep your look balanced without looking harsh.

Party.title: Your soft spotlight
Party.tagline: A little shimmer. A very memorable entrance.

makeup.label: Base
makeup.tip: Long-wear cool-neutral foundation over a hydrating primer.

makeup.label: Eyes
makeup.tip: Press lavender shimmer onto lids; define with soft navy liner.

makeup.label: Blush
makeup.tip: Layer cool rose cream and powder blush for all-night color.

makeup.label: Lips
makeup.tip: A blue-based berry lip stain, blotted once before a second coat.

makeup.label: Finish
makeup.tip: Set with fine translucent powder and alcohol-free setting spray.

outfit.label: Pieces
outfit.tip: A periwinkle satin midi dress or a soft navy jumpsuit.

outfit.label: Extras
outfit.tip: Silver sandals and a small metallic clutch.

outfit.label: Jewelry
outfit.tip: Statement silver earrings with cool-toned crystals.

hair.label: Style
hair.tip: Glossy brushed-out waves swept to one side.

hair.label: Detail
hair.tip: Pin the lighter side back so your statement earrings shine.

Party.goodToKnow: Skip SPF-heavy base for flash photos if it causes flashback; test a quick photo before heading out.

Picnic.title: Daylight daydream
Picnic.tagline: Fresh, breezy color for an afternoon outside.

makeup.label: Base
makeup.tip: SPF 50 under a light skin tint; let freckles show through.

makeup.label: Eyes
makeup.tip: A wash of cool taupe and waterproof mascara for warm afternoons.

makeup.label: Blush
makeup.tip: Blend a sheer rose cream blush with your fingertips.

makeup.label: Lips
makeup.tip: Cool pink SPF balm, reapplied after snacks and drinks.

makeup.label: Finish
makeup.tip: Blot shine gently; avoid heavy powder in direct sunlight.

outfit.label: Pieces
outfit.tip: A lavender cotton sundress with a light dove-gray cardigan.

outfit.label: Extras
outfit.tip: Canvas sneakers, a pale bucket hat, and a washable tote.

outfit.label: Jewelry
outfit.tip: Small silver studs that will not snag on your blanket.

hair.label: Style
hair.tip: A relaxed half-up style to keep hair out of your face.

hair.label: Detail
hair.tip: Secure with a soft lavender scrunchie, not a tight elastic.

Picnic.goodToKnow: Reapply sunscreen every two hours outdoors; your pretty hat is extra protection, not a replacement.

Hiking.title: Fresh air, fresh face
Hiking.tagline: Trail-ready essentials that go the distance.

makeup.label: Base
makeup.tip: SPF 50 sunscreen only, tinted if you like.

makeup.label: Eyes
makeup.tip: Skip shadow; use a single coat of waterproof mascara if desired.

makeup.label: Blush
makeup.tip: Let the trail bring your natural flush; skip extra blush.

makeup.label: Lips
makeup.tip: SPF lip balm with a rose tint.

makeup.label: Finish
makeup.tip: No setting powder; pack blotting papers for sweaty stops.

outfit.label: Pieces
outfit.tip: A soft-teal moisture-wicking tee with slate hiking trousers.

outfit.label: Extras
outfit.tip: Broken-in trail shoes, a powder-blue cap, and a daypack.

outfit.label: Jewelry
outfit.tip: Tiny flat silver studs only; leave rings and chains at home.

hair.label: Style
hair.tip: A secure low braid that fits comfortably beneath your cap.

hair.label: Detail
hair.tip: Use snag-free ties and tuck short strands under the cap.

Hiking.goodToKnow: Sweat-proof matters more than shade on the trail.
